name: Döbörhegy (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, light grey at the hoist and red at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Döbörhegy: a red shield with a figure of Saint Anne with the Virgin, within a green wreath, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Döbörhegy arms with wreath and scroll
